visual_action: Kamala Harris stands at a podium with two microphones, speaking to an unseen audience. A large sign with red text, which appears to read "EMILY'S LIST", is visible in the background.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris is the sole person shown on screen, speaking for the entire duration of the video. On-screen text also identifies her as "Vice President Harris".

on_screen_text.text: Vice President Harris with the facts 💯
tells us most of these men

spoken_summary: Kamala Harris argues that many women are not aware they are pregnant at six weeks. She asserts that this fact demonstrates that "most of these men" who support early-term abortion bans do not understand how a woman's body works. The clip ends with audience applause.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of Kamala Harris's speech, followed by applause from the audience. There is no music.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot of a talking head with no cuts or camera movement.
central_claim: Men who advocate for six-week abortion bans are ignorant of female biology because many women don't even know they are pregnant at that point.
intended_effect: To rally support for abortion rights by portraying opponents as uninformed and to present Kamala Harris as a knowledgeable advocate for women.
